20:30 │ EN VIVO AHORA: NHL Hockey
The Dallas Stars host the Colorado Avalanche in a Central Division clash at American Airlines Center. Nathan MacKinnon leads the Avalanche in points, goals and assists, while Mikko Rantanen leads the Stars in points, goals and assists as well.

23:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NHL Hockey
The San Jose Sharks host the Boston Bruins for a late-night cross-conference showdown at SAP Center at San Jose. David Pastrnak leads the Bruins in points, goals and assists, while Macklin Celebrini leads the Sharks in points and assists.
